title: ARTIFICIAL AFTER ALL
author: Han Saglam
description: Two hundred fifty-six sovereign contracts, each carrying its own seed and a compressed neural network embedded in Ethereum bytecode. A call to artificial() expands the seed into a 32-dimensional latent and runs the whole forward pass — dense layer, three transposed-convolution blocks, a 1×1 convolution head — in fixed-point EVM arithmetic, returning the 1024 pixels of a 32×32 grayscale image. Nothing fetched from IPFS, nothing served: the work is computed at call time rather than stored. The address here is one example piece; the factory at 0xa7a3022249415e25752C4cF8696c2418DEfdF2Db deployed all 256 and exposes isArtificial(address).

call.note: artificial() — returns an ABI-encoded 1024-byte 32×32 pixel buffer (1088 raw bytes)
